notes.DUMBBELL: pairs, up to 10kg each; can also be foot-anchored via the ankle strap (see ankle_strap)
notes.BAND: elastic resistance bands (tube-style) AND fabric hip loops (see hip_bands) - both map to BAND for validation
notes.BOX: the flat bench doubles as a step-up box - Garmin tags every *_STEP_UP exercise (e.g. DUMBBELL_STEP_UP) with BOX, not BENCH, even though a bench serves the same function
notes.ankle_strap: TOPJUM foot/ankle strap that anchors a dumbbell to the top of the foot - functionally an ANKLE_WEIGHT (that is the Garmin equipment token to use). Enables weighted hip-flexor raises, leg raises, and glute kickbacks (e.g. LEG_RAISE/WEIGHTED_LYING_STRAIGHT_LEG_RAISE, LEG_RAISE/WEIGHTED_QUADRUPED_LEG_RAISE). Load = the DB weight strapped on.
notes.hip_bands: 3x fabric hip resistance loops (light/medium/heavy) worn above the knees - glute-medius/abductor activation (banded squats, lateral/monster walks, clamshells, banded glute bridge, fire hydrants). Directly PTT-relevant: hip-abductor strength reduces femoral internal rotation -> less pronation -> less posterior tibial tendon load. Maps to BAND for validation.
notes.other: tibial bar + incline bench for tibialis anterior raises - not in Garmin's equipment vocabulary, use category=None/exerciseName=None with a descriptive desc instead
